queries.compiledQueryString:
SELECT
  sectors,
  SUM(CAST(ai AS INTEGER)) as AI,
  SUM(CAST(deeptech AS INTEGER)) as DeepTech,
  SUM(CAST(spacetech AS INTEGER)) as SpaceTech,
  SUM(CAST(defense_tech_dual_use AS INTEGER)) as DefenseTech
FROM
  startups.data
WHERE
  sectors IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  sectors
ORDER BY
  sectors
